- Coordination and sequencing:

  - Announce which skill(s) you're using and why (one short line). If you skip an obvious skill, say why.

cat > /tmp/render_chart.py <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

DATA_PATH = Path('/app/benchmark/source_data.json')
OUT = Path('/app/output/result.png')
OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

with DATA_PATH.open() as f:
    data = json.load(f)

regions = ['Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia', 'Europe', 'North America']
short = {'Sub-Saharan Africa':'Sub-Saharan\nAfrica', 'South Asia':'South Asia', 'Europe':'Europe', 'North America':'North America'}
colors = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': '#9B3D24',
    'South Asia': '#C17A00',
    'Europe': '#1F77B4',
    'North America': '#12355B',
}
low_band = '#F7E5DA'
high_band = '#E6EEF6'
bg = '#FAF7F1'
ink = '#1B1B1B'
muted = '#6B6B6B'
grid = '#D9D2C7'
axis = '#6F6A61'

income = {(d['region'], d['quintile']): d['penetration'] for d in data['internet_by_income_quintile']['data']}
age = {(d['region'], d['age_group']): d['penetration'] for d in data['internet_by_age_group']['data']}
urban = {(d['region'], d['setting']): d['penetration'] for d in data['internet_by_urban_rural']['data']}
overall = {d['region']: d['overall_penetration'] for d in data['internet_overall_by_region']['data']}
pop = {d['region']: d['population_millions'] for d in data['internet_overall_by_region']['data']}
users = {d['region']: d['internet_users_millions'] for d in data['internet_overall_by_region']['data']}

W, H = 2200, 1500
img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), bg)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def font(size, bold=False):
    candidates = [
        '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf' if bold else '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',
        '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation2/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf' if bold else '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation2/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf',
        '/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc',
        '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/wqy/wqy-zenhei.ttc',
    ]
    for p in candidates:
        try:
            return ImageFont.truetype(p, size)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return ImageFont.load_default()

F_TITLE = font(54, True)
F_SUB = font(26)
F_HDR = font(25, True)
F_LABEL = font(24, True)
F_SMALL = font(20)
F_TINY = font(17)
F_NUM = font(23, True)
F_CALLOUT = font(21, True)

# Helpers

def text(x, y, s, fill=ink, f=F_SMALL, anchor='la', align='left', spacing=4):
    d.multiline_text((x, y), s, fill=fill, font=f, anchor=anchor, align=align, spacing=spacing)

def bbox_text(x, y, s, f, pad=8, fill='#FFFFFF', outline=None, txt=ink, anchor='mm'):
    bb = d.textbbox((x, y), s, font=f, anchor=anchor)
    rect = (bb[0]-pad, bb[1]-pad//2, bb[2]+pad, bb[3]+pad//2)
    d.rounded_rectangle(rect, radius=8, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=1 if outline else 0)
    d.text((x, y), s, font=f, fill=txt, anchor=anchor)

def line(points, fill, width=3):
    d.line(points, fill=fill, width=width, joint='curve')

def circle(x, y, r, fill, outline=None, width=2):
    d.ellipse((x-r, y-r, x+r, y+r), fill=fill, outline=outline or fill, width=width)

def triangle(x, y, r, fill, outline=None):
    pts = [(x, y-r), (x-r*0.9, y+r*0.75), (x+r*0.9, y+r*0.75)]
    d.polygon(pts, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        d.line(pts+[pts[0]], fill=outline, width=2)

def diamond(x, y, r, fill, outline=None):
    pts = [(x, y-r), (x+r, y), (x, y+r), (x-r, y)]
    d.polygon(pts, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        d.line(pts+[pts[0]], fill=outline, width=2)

def xmap(val, x0, x1):
    return x0 + (x1-x0) * val / 100.0

def draw_axis(x0, x1, y0, y1, label=False):
    for t in [0,25,50,75,100]:
        x = xmap(t, x0, x1)
        d.line((x, y0, x, y1), fill=grid, width=1)
        if label:
            d.text((x, y1+18), str(t), fill=muted, font=F_TINY, anchor='mt')
    d.line((x0, y1, x1, y1), fill=axis, width=2)

# Title block
d.rectangle((0,0,W,138), fill='#F2ECE2')
text(90, 48, 'Digital divide, 2023: every inequality dimension points the same way', f=F_TITLE)
text(92, 110, 'Internet penetration rate (% of people) by region, income, settlement, and age. Lines show within-region gaps; labels show percentage-point spreads.', fill='#3E3A35', f=F_SUB)

# Layout
left_region = 82
region_w = 260
chart_top = 250
row_h = 245
row_gap = 34
chart_bottom = chart_top + 4*row_h
cols = {
    'overall': (390, 620),
    'income': (730, 1190),
    'urban': (1305, 1595),
    'age': (1720, 2070),
}
headers = [
    ('Region context', 'overall', 'overall rate; population context'),
    ('Income gradient', 'income', 'Q1 (lowest) → Q5 (highest)'),
    ('Urban–rural split', 'urban', 'Rural → Urban'),
    ('Youth–elder contrast', 'age', '65+ → 15–24'),
]

# Column headers and axes
text(left_region, 196, 'Region', f=F_HDR)
for title, key, sub in headers:
    x0, x1 = cols[key]
    d.text(((x0+x1)//2, 188), title, font=F_HDR, fill=ink, anchor='mm')
    d.text(((x0+x1)//2, 220), sub, font=F_TINY, fill=muted, anchor='mm')
    draw_axis(x0, x1, 236, chart_bottom+15, label=False)
# bottom axis labels once per column
for key in cols:
    x0, x1 = cols[key]
    draw_axis(x0, x1, chart_bottom+34, chart_bottom+34, label=True)
    d.text(((x0+x1)//2, chart_bottom+76), 'Internet penetration (%)', font=F_TINY, fill=muted, anchor='mm')

# Background row bands
for i, r in enumerate(regions):
    y = chart_top + i*row_h
    fill = low_band if i < 2 else high_band
    d.rounded_rectangle((54, y-55, W-70, y+155), radius=16, fill=fill if i in [0,1] else '#EEF3F8', outline='#E2DDD4')
    # subtle white overlay in charts for readability
    d.rounded_rectangle((350, y-42, W-95, y+142), radius=10, fill='#FFFFFF')

# redraw grid over white panels per row
for title, key, sub in headers:
    x0, x1 = cols[key]
    for t in [0,25,50,75,100]:
        x = xmap(t, x0, x1)
        d.line((x, chart_top-43, x, chart_top+3*row_h+142), fill=grid, width=1)

# Region labels and plots
quints = ['Q1 (Lowest)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5 (Highest)']
age_groups = ['65+', '55-64', '45-54', '35-44', '25-34', '15-24']

for i, r in enumerate(regions):
    y = chart_top + i*row_h + 38
    c = colors[r]
    # region label
    d.rectangle((76, y-62, 90, y+76), fill=c)
    text(108, y-38, short[r], fill=ink, f=F_LABEL)
    text(108, y+28, f"Pop. {pop[r]:,}M • users {users[r]:,}M", fill=muted, f=F_TINY)

    # Overall bar
    x0, x1 = cols['overall']
    ox = xmap(overall[r], x0, x1)
    d.rounded_rectangle((x0, y-18, ox, y+18), radius=9, fill=c)
    d.rounded_rectangle((x0, y-18, x1, y+18), radius=9, outline='#BEB7AD', width=1)
    d.text((ox+12, y), f"{overall[r]}%", fill=c, font=F_NUM, anchor='lm')

    # Income quintiles: connected dot gradient
    x0, x1 = cols['income']
    vals = [income[(r, q)] for q in quints]
    pts = [(xmap(v, x0, x1), y) for v in vals]
    line(pts, fill=c, width=5)
    for j, (x, _) in enumerate(pts):
        rr = 7 + j*1
        circle(x, y, rr, fill='#FFFFFF', outline=c, width=3)
    circle(pts[0][0], y, 10, fill=bg, outline=c, width=3)
    circle(pts[-1][0], y, 12, fill=c, outline=c, width=3)
    d.text((pts[0][0], y-34), f"Q1 {vals[0]}", fill=c, font=F_TINY, anchor='mm')
    d.text((pts[-1][0], y-40), f"Q5 {vals[-1]}", fill=c, font=F_TINY, anchor='mm')
    gap = vals[-1]-vals[0]
    bbox_text((pts[0][0]+pts[-1][0])/2, y+42, f"+{gap} pp", F_CALLOUT, fill='#FFF8ED', outline='#E4D4B8', txt=c)

    # Urban rural dumbbell
    x0, x1 = cols['urban']
    rural = urban[(r, 'Rural')]
    urb = urban[(r, 'Urban')]
    xr, xu = xmap(rural, x0, x1), xmap(urb, x0, x1)
    line([(xr, y), (xu, y)], fill=c, width=5)
    diamond(xr, y, 13, fill='#FFFFFF', outline=c)
    circle(xu, y, 13, fill=c, outline=c)
    d.text((xr, y-36), f"R {rural}", fill=c, font=F_TINY, anchor='mm')
    d.text((xu, y-36), f"U {urb}", fill=c, font=F_TINY, anchor='mm')
    bbox_text((xr+xu)/2, y+42, f"+{urb-rural} pp", F_CALLOUT, fill='#F6FBFF', outline='#C9D9E8', txt=c)

    # Age gradient
    x0, x1 = cols['age']
    vals_age = [age[(r, a)] for a in age_groups]
    pts_age = [(xmap(v, x0, x1), y) for v in vals_age]
    line(pts_age, fill=c, width=5)
    # intermediate small dots
    for j, (x, _) in enumerate(pts_age):
        if j == 0:
            diamond(x, y, 13, fill='#FFFFFF', outline=c)
        elif j == len(pts_age)-1:
            triangle(x, y, 15, fill=c, outline=c)
        else:
            circle(x, y, 7, fill='#FFFFFF', outline=c, width=2)
    elder = age[(r, '65+')]
    youth = age[(r, '15-24')]
    xe, xy = xmap(elder, x0, x1), xmap(youth, x0, x1)
    d.text((xe, y-36), f"65+ {elder}", fill=c, font=F_TINY, anchor='mm')
    d.text((xy, y-40), f"15–24 {youth}", fill=c, font=F_TINY, anchor='mm')
    bbox_text((xe+xy)/2, y+42, f"+{youth-elder} pp", F_CALLOUT, fill='#F6FBFF', outline='#C9D9E8', txt=c)

# Emphasis annotations
# Regional disparity callouts comparing low vs high in overall and endpoints
x0, x1 = cols['overall']
y_ssa = chart_top + 38
y_na = chart_top + 3*row_h + 38
d.line((xmap(overall['Sub-Saharan Africa'], x0, x1)+10, y_ssa+35, xmap(overall['North America'], x0, x1)-8, y_na-35), fill='#3A3A3A', width=2)
bbox_text(585, 1028, '66 pp overall\nNorth America vs.\nSub-Saharan Africa', F_TINY, fill='#FFFFFF', outline='#8A8177', txt=ink)

# Largest/narrowest gap notes
bbox_text(1460, 635, 'Largest urban–rural\ngap: South Asia\n36 pp', F_TINY, fill='#FFFFFF', outline='#8A8177', txt=ink)
bbox_text(1865, 1142, 'Age gaps remain\nlarge even in\nhigh-penetration\nregions', F_TINY, fill='#FFFFFF', outline='#8A8177', txt=ink)

# Legend/footer
legend_y = 1390
d.rectangle((0, 1334, W, H), fill='#F2ECE2')
text(84, 1362, 'Legend', f=F_HDR)
# region colors
